# memlayer

> Persistent memory for AI coding agents: local, per-project, no cloud.
> SQLite under ~/.memlayer/, CLI + gRPC daemon, MCP tools, hybrid BM25 + dense search.

memlayer is open source (MIT OR Apache-2.0). Source: https://github.com/sanudatta11/memlayer

## Docs

- [Overview](https://memlayer.org/): Product overview and demo video
- [Install](https://memlayer.org/docs/install/): Build from source (Rust), PATH, doctor
- [Getting started](https://memlayer.org/docs/getting-started/): End-to-end tour
- [Wire into your agent](https://memlayer.org/docs/agents/): MCP, git verify hooks, MEMLAYER_LLM_*
- [Observations](https://memlayer.org/docs/observations/): Save, recent, history, reextract
- [Search and context](https://memlayer.org/docs/search-context/): Hybrid retrieval, token budgets
- [Anchors and verify](https://memlayer.org/docs/anchors-verify/): path::symbol digests, stale withdrawal
- [Decide](https://memlayer.org/docs/decide/): Conflict recommendation via agent CLI
- [Mem archives](https://memlayer.org/docs/mem/): Portable .mem export/import
- [Config](https://memlayer.org/docs/config/): TOML overlays and env overrides
- [LoCoMo eval](https://memlayer.org/docs/locomo/): Smoke, full, staleness
- [Troubleshooting](https://memlayer.org/docs/troubleshooting/): Doctor and common failures
- [Command cheat sheet](https://memlayer.org/docs/commands/): Dense command index

## For coding agents (repo)

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/sanudatta11/memlayer/blob/main/AGENTS.md): OpenCode / Codex / local LLM contributor instructions

- [llms-full.txt](https://memlayer.org/llms-full.txt): Longer plain-text summary for LLM ingestion
